I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random to say I've noted her correction. From now on I'll use the corrected seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal instead of the number from her #north-team post this morning.

I left the seat count itself out of the reply. I didn't check who is in #north-random, and seat counts should only go to the account's team and org-wide roles.

As she asked, I took no other action and didn't post a correction in #north-team.
